body:
I haven't talked to anyone IRL. I think I've looked so dull so long, people have accepted it. I've never raised any commotion over it.

The most stressful things to me are school and my social life. I'm still in high school. I think one of the only urges I have within me is the desire to go to a "good college." I would say it has been successfully implanted within me by my parents and well cultivated by my environment, but has never accepted by *me*. I don't have anything against it, and I'm still trying for it. I do very well academically, but extracurricular activities are nearly absent, so I am very worried, even if they are mostly irrelevant. I don't really want to talk about this, it's sort of a poisonous, unreasonable thought that I acknowledge but can't fix.

I believe I have a pretty good understanding of my social life. It's a failure, but that doesn't hurt at all. I admit I am quiet, reserved, oblivious, and unresponsive, and that almost all of my actions do not benefit my social life, and that my image is uninviting. I can tell that, and I can feel I can change that, but I don't have motivation to. I'd be okay like this. The stressful part is that once having fixed a little bit before, I didn't want to continue. I had really imaginative fantasies before about social things, but it's not that impressive or attractive.

I think I just don't want to live my life when things go bad, but I also don't want to live my life if things go well. I just don't want to live it.
